text:
Maya (Partnerships): 72hr check: marketplace GTM items. Call out must-fix blockers now.
Omar (Product): Listing copy done. Need final hero and partner logo locks.
Sofia (Marketing): Hero approved for EN; holding FR/ES variants. Can we launch EN first and swap localized later?
Maya (Partnerships): OK to swap as long as layout consistent. Legal signoff on logos?
Legal (Counsel): Partner logos OK except PartnerX needs signed brand use addendum. Deadline EOD tomorrow.
PartnerRep: Sending signed addendum in 2 hours. Will confirm.
Dev (Engineering): Integration tests mostly green. One CI flake on tenant create in eu-central; adding retry logic now.
Isha (Platform): I'll add a temporary throttle to dedicated listings to avoid coldstart thundering herd during launch window.
Sofia (Marketing): Embargo set for 10am GMT Thursday. Press release + blog + partner email to go live together.
Omar (Product): Who owns partner landing copy? I can draft if Dev provides a short integration snippet.
Dev (Engineering): Snippet ready: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"eu-central-1"}'
```
Sofia (Marketing): UTM pattern: ?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloud_launch. Using that for all assets.
Maya (Partnerships): Assets matrix: hero (Sofia), logos (PartnerRep + Legal), snippet (Dev), listing screenshots (Omar), throttles & runbook (Isha). Any other owners?
Legal (Counsel): Approving privacy blurb: "Usage data is processed per Redwood and partner terms." Partner consent needed.
PartnerRep: Consent confirmed.
Isha (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:30 GMT tomorrow. I'll post results here.
Dev (Engineering): Retry PR in staging; CI green.
Sofia (Marketing): I'll queue social and briefing to press list once Legal confirms final quote.
Maya (Partnerships): Good. If preflight is green we meet for final go/no-go Fri 09:00 GMT. Keep this thread for blockers only.
Isha (Platform): Preflight complete: provisioning and redirect chain OK, throttle behaving as expected. Marking green-with-note (monitoring).
Maya (Partnerships): All green. Closing this scrub; open an incidents channel post-launch. Thank you. :rocket:
